nary_nodes.label: Anil Menon on family role reversal
evidence: Menon said staying at home with the kids while his wife flew in space was more difficult than he expected. Now that their roles are reversed, both are gaining a better understanding of the challenges faced by both.
When we talk about what it was like for her to launch and me to be on the ground... I think, like, either side of this... we understand each other a bit better.

nary_nodes.label: Dubrov on crew welcome tradition
evidence: It's a great tradition when the arriving crew is welcomed by the smiley faces of our crewmates... We passed a lot of time together during our training, and now we are here all together on the station.
